commands.review_summary:
The PR hardens RunPod stop/release around exact local claims, adds RunPod regression and live-smoke coverage, updates live-smoke dispatch, and documents the new stop behavior.

Reproducibility: yes. Source inspection shows current main can terminate a raw RunPod CloudID without a bound local claim, and the latest PR head still has a source-reproducible slug/provider-ID collision in resolveRunpodClaim.

target.title: fix: bind RunPod release to exact claims
target.body:
## Summary

- bind RunPod destructive operations to exact local claims containing provider ID and pod name
- require explicit `--reclaim` adoption for unclaimed or legacy pods; never silently retarget an existing claim
- re-read the pod under the release lock and verify both ID and name before deletion
- reject ambiguous exact, normalized-name, and derived-lease lookups instead of adopting the first provider result
- preserve exact created-pod identity through readiness failure cleanup
- add a cleanup-armed, isolated-state RunPod live lifecycle canary and top-level live-smoke dispatch

Closes https://github.com/openclaw/crabbox/issues/801

## Verification

Current candidate: `109465350f2763c649e153f5827a70c7f44dc44e`

Local validation across the candidate stack:

- `git diff --check main...HEAD` — pass.
- `go test -race ./internal/providers/runpod ./internal/cli -count=1` — pass.
- `go vet ./internal/providers/runpod ./internal/cli` — pass.
- `scripts/check-docs.sh` — pass; 53 command docs, 71 provider-matrix rows, 207 Markdown files, and the generated docs site verified.
- `node --test scripts/live-runpod-smoke.test.js scripts/live-smoke.test.js` — 58 tests passed, including cleanup, secret-redaction, non-empty-inventory refusal, and dispatch coverage.
- Full-branch autoreview — clean, no accepted/actionable findings (0.82).

All 11 hosted checks pass on the exact current candidate, including Go (14m25s), Release Check, Apple VZ, and CodeQL.

## Pre-merge live gate

The dedicated stored RunPod E2E key was tried against this exact head. `doctor --provider runpod` failed with HTTP 401 before pod creation; the isolated canary made no provider mutation and left zero residue. Keep this PR unmerged until the stored key is replaced and `scripts/live-runpod-smoke.sh` proves real pod create, SSH command execution, exact-claim stop, and zero-residue inventory cleanup; alternatively record an explicit item-specific waiver.

## Security / configuration

No new persisted-secret requirement. The live canary accepts `CRABBOX_RUNPOD_API_KEY` or `RUNPOD_API_KEY` only from the process environment and isolates its Crabbox state.
